action_instruction: Checking whether the cart total matches the sum of line-item subtotals
intent: whether the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed line-item subtotals

action_params.condition: the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed line-item subtotals
action_params.query: whether the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed line-item subtotals
action_params.code_js: (() => { const root = el(8); if (!root) return null; const subtotals = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.cart-line-subtotal')).map(n => parseFloat((n.textContent || '').replace(/[^\d.]/g, ''))).filter(n => !Number.isNaN(n)); const totalEl = root.querySelector('.cart-total'); const total = totalEl ? parseFloat((totalEl.textContent || '').replace(/[^\d.]/g, '')) : NaN; if (Number.isNaN(total) || subtotals.length === 0) return null; const sum = subtotals.reduce((a,b) => a + b, 0); return Math.abs(sum - total) < 0.005; })()
locators: internal:text="👟 Trail Runner Sneakers $89.00 − 2 + $178.00 Remove Total: $"i

assertion_tree.description: the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed line-item subtotals

sub_results.description: the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed line-item subtotals

assertion_tree.verification: Look for the cart-wide total and the displayed line-item subtotals, and confirm they are equal
